name: Maison Velle
fit: Fashion houses, jewellers, galleries, hospitality and any brand that sells restraint at a high price
keywords: couture fashion luxury bodoni ivory oxblood arch lookbook atelier editorial high contrast serif
idea: A couture house's seasonal invitation: ivory stock, a fat-and-hairline Didone at poster scale, and one tall arch of draped oxblood satin that stands in for the garment.
note: Live: pick a look (click or arrow keys). The name re-inks with a wipe, the arch changes cloth, and a slow sheen crosses the fabric.
borrowed: Printed fashion-week invitations and magazine mastheads: Didone contrast, letter-spaced caps, hairline rules, the arched window of a salon doorway, bolts of satin lit from one side.
mood: Expensive, hushed and certain. Everything is spaced out except the headline, which is the only loud thing in the room. Suits brands with real product photography to lean on. Avoid for anything that needs density, such as dashboards, shops with filters or long forms.

palette.name: Oxblood
palette.role: the one accent: italic words, hover, fabric

type.meta: Display · Bodoni Moda 400, italic 600 for the accent word

motion: The look name wipes in with `clip-path: inset()` over 900ms, `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`.
A skewed highlight crosses the cloth every 7s; it is the only ambient motion.
Buttons fill upward with oxblood; the text link's underline retracts.
watchouts: Do not add a second accent. Oxblood must stay rare or the page turns into a wine label.
Hairlines vanish on low-quality screens; keep rules at full ink or the 22% hair tone, nothing lighter.
The Didone's thin strokes need size. Below about 28px use Jost.
